stated: The Conservative Party will require schools to ban the use of mobile phones during the school day, putting existing guidance on a statutory footing and providing funding for implementation.

source.quote: Protect children by requiring schools to ban the use of mobile phones during the school day... We will put our guidance on banning mobile phones in the school day on a statutory footing which will require all schools to operate a ban, as the best schools already do.

bearing_set.reason: A statutory school-day phone ban directly targets the learning environment and school standards, with evidence linking phone restrictions to improved attainment and reduced distraction — particularly for lower-income and lower-attaining pupils, touching the attainment gap indicator.

Placing the ban on statutory footing converts discretionary guidance into a legal mandate on schools and pupils, moving the 'freedom from state coercion / mandates' indicator — the incremental coercive step beyond existing guidance is a real, non-negligible liberty effect.

membership_note: Policy is primarily targeted at O7 (education quality and attainment); the statutory mechanism creates a genuine, if modest, O10 bearing by removing school and pupil discretion through legal compulsion rather than guidance.
